desc: Build the tree as an adjacency list from input edges.
Root the tree at node 1 and perform iterative DFS to get post-order traversal order.
For each node in post-order, compute dp1, dp3, dp4 using sorted child contributions max(dp1[child], dp3[child]).
Track the maximum valid dp4 across all nodes as the answer.
Handle edge cases: if no valid dp4 exists, output -1.
Test the current solution against the three sample inputs to verify correctness.
Consider if a subtree could have a degree-4 node that is not the root of the DP tree and whether the DP misses such configurations.
Consider the case where a valid alkane has its degree-4 node not as the root of the overall DP tree, and verify that rooting at 1 still allows capturing it via some node's dp4 state.
Ensure O(N) time complexity and correct handling of N up to 2*10^5.
